## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `make check` or both direct validation commands.
- [ ] I updated related documents, templates, sitemap entries, or website metadata if needed.
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` for material standards, governance, process, or public website changes.
- [ ] I completed the accessibility and site-quality checklist for meaningful website changes.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private data, confidential reports, active vulnerability details, or abuse paths.
- [ ] I documented rationale, assumptions, tradeoffs, unresolved risks, and reassessment needs.
- [ ] I requested subject-matter review when the change affects ethics, privacy, safety, accessibility, governance, or public accountability.
